HOW TO PLAY

Scratch. Watch. Freeze.

Tap as much as you can while the owner faces away. If you scratch while they are watching, you’re caught.

👆 TAPEach scratch earns a point.
⚠️ WARNINGThe room flashes before someone turns.
👀 FREEZEDo absolutely nothing until they look away.

A playful game—not pet-care advice. A real itchy cat should be checked by a veterinarian.
